title: v1_145 / October 29, 2026
content:
## October 29, 2026

* Add support for disabling Copilot's `Co-authored-by` commit trailer in new or resumed agent-host sessions with `setting(chat.agentHost.copilot.includeCoAuthoredBy)` set to `false`. _[microsoft/vscode#342213: Allow disabling Copilot's Co-authored-by trailer in agent-host sessions](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/342213)_
